shop: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: full opaque portrait background painting for existing fantasy game screen. REPAINT THE ENTIRE FIRST IMAGE into the coherent clean hand-painted illustration style of image 2 and image 3. Image 1 is exact composition, scene identity and spatial layout reference; images 2 and 3 are strict art-direction references only. Do not insert their buildings, islands or objects into this scene. Replace ALL original glossy 3D/HDR rendering with clean defined matte painted shapes, soft diffuse natural light, gentle shape shading, restrained moss/teal/slate and natural wood palette. Main decorative and character details remain distinctly readable, but no noisy microtexture, glitter, lacquer shine, harsh black outlines, giant gold reflections, dramatic depth-of-field blur or bokeh. All foliage has crisp individual tapered leaves in overlapping sprays with subtle central folds, no blurry puffy bush blobs. Distant scenery uses clean simplified atmospheric color shapes, not defocus blur. The scene must look made by the same artist as the approved references, not just recolored. Preserve the exact original portrait composition, perspective and framing. Keep every major existing object, character, surface, horizontal shelf, floor and counter at its original relative position and scale; these coordinates align to interactive UI drawn separately. Preserve large existing quiet/empty functional surfaces and DO NOT fill them with new objects. Preserve original character identities, face expressions, ears, costumes and poses, but repaint them with softer 2D storybook materials. All original existing banners/signs remain blank or retain only their existing decorative symbols, no text or invented letters. Do not add any UI, status bars, button, title sign overlay, frame, item card, or extra actors/interactables. No watermark. Full-bleed opaque portrait canvas, no transparency, no border. Reduce excessive orange/gold HDR light; existing lamps/fire remain modest warm local accents balanced with soft daylight. Scene-specific invariants: mushroom-roof outdoor potion shop under large tree at left, existing blank white hanging banner at upper left, distant castle/cliffs in blue sky upper right. Keep the bare rustic curved wooden mounting structure above the shop blank. Preserve the silver-haired blue-eyed catgirl shopkeeper and white bunny at the middle counter, sleeping calico cat at right, same shelf bottles behind them. The counter edge stays around 45-50% image height. Crucially, the TWO LARGE EMPTY HORIZONTAL WOODEN DISPLAY SHELVES in the lower half remain COMPLETELY EMPTY with shelf planes at their exact original heights around 59% and 69% and the broad wood surfaces unchanged in size, reserved for live UI products. Keep the path in bottom quarter unobstructed, flower borders crisp, no foreground blur. Match source canvas 941 by 1672 portrait.
